description: Outlook desktop "forward as attachment". Shows that a client's fingerprint survives the attachment path even with an empty compose body.
outerSubject: FW: Semana 13 — conferencia de zona y una llanta ponchada

original.subject: Semana 13 — conferencia de zona y una llanta ponchada

notes: The compose body is empty, yet the wrapper still base64-encodes a WordSection1 stylesheet block that Outlook web omits entirely. Relaying through a shared Exchange Online tenant does not normalize client output.
The outer Message-ID is folded onto a continuation line.
The message/rfc822 part carries its own Content-ID (an @namprd07.prod.outlook.com value) that has no cid: reference anywhere in the body. A Content-ID is not evidence that a part is an inline image.
